Lina (CSM): Cedarwell Health just dropped ~65% in daily API calls overnight. Their ML lead gave notice and left on Friday. Procurement asked for a vendor cost snapshot after a partner demo. Renewal is 4 weeks out. Can we triage and assemble a retention play? :red_circle:
Omar (CS Ops): On it. First question: is this an application-side key rotation or something blocked by their network? Any recent billing or quota flags?
Lina (CSM): No billing alerts. Tenant shows activity stopped ~36h ago. They still have Dedicated capacity reserved but nothing hitting it. Champion was running model tuning jobs.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Common causes: rotated token, IP/egress allowlist, or they switched to the cheaper model variant and hit a throttling policy. Quick test for them to run from their infra: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $CEDAR_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health
``` If 401/403 -> token issue; 429 -> throttling; 5xx -> edge issue.
infra-bot: [auto] 2025-03-03T02:07:12Z - edge: brief spike in 502/504 for us-west-2 between 02:04-02:11 UTC. Affected requests: ~860.
Omar (CS Ops): I pulled their tenant logs: saw a cluster of 403s starting 02:02 UTC and then a lull. No quota bumps requested. Also saw a handful of 429s during the window. Looks like key rejected then they retried and hit a burst throttle.
Jules (AE): Procurement mentioned CompetitorY's demo emphasized a managed connector + lower per-token list price. If it's a simple key/allowlist fix and we show better p95 latency and total cost of ownership we can keep the renewal. Suggest: 1) 7-day Dedicated extension 2) 30-min triage with eng 3) benchmark doc (p50/p95, token cost, ops overhead).
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a micro-playbook: validation steps + quick KV cache enablement and batching flags to flip on trial. Also a tiny benchmark harness they can run in their environment to prove latency/cost. Example python snippet to hit the models endpoint and measure p95: ```python
import requests, time
H={'Authorization':'Bearer $CEDAR_TOKEN'}
latencies=[]
for _ in range(20):
  t0=time.time(); requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', headers=H, json={"model":"rwd-ttl-1","input":"test"}); latencies.append((time.time()-t0)*1000)
print(sorted(latencies)[int(0.95*len(latencies))])
```
Omar (CS Ops): Action items: @Priya produce playbook + harness (ETA today EOD). @Lina schedule triage slot Mon AM with their PM & procurement. @Jules offer 7-day Dedicated extension and send benchmark summary. I'll create a short-lived support token for them to run the checks and flag billing to pause auto-invoice if we extend.
Lina (CSM): I'll message their PM & procurement now and offer next-available slot. If no reply by EOD I'll escalate to our exec sponsor.
Jules (AE): I'll craft the benchmark sheet showing apples-to-apples cost (same model, same prompt mix) and call out "ops delta" vs their competitor plugin. No pricing promises; will include finance contact.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Posted initial checklist: 1) Confirm token validity (401/403) 2) Confirm IP allowlist/VPN firewall 3) Run health & generate tests (snippets above) 4) If 429 -> check tenant throttles and request transient bump 5) Enable KV cache + batching flags 6) Collect request IDs & logs for us to triage.
Omar (CS Ops): Noted. Also: if they request the Dedicated extension, we need a manual billing hold. I'll coordinate with billing.
Lina (CSM): Thanks team. Goal: fix in 48h, run benchmark within 72h, and propose a retention pilot if numbers look favorable. Will update here after their reply. :white_check_mark:
